newsitem.title: USA: Micron Elec falls, presentation cancelled.
newsitem.headline: Micron Elec falls, presentation cancelled.

text.p: Shares of Micron Electronics Inc fell in late trading Tuesday on a flurry of rumors after the company cancelled a presentation at the Smith Barney Technology conference earlier today, traders said.
A Smith Barney spokeswoman could not immediately comment. Micron officials in public relations were in a meeting and did not return calls seeking comment.

Traders said that a flurry of rumors were fueling a drop in Micron's stock, including speculation that it might announce that business was not going well or that earnings may be below Wall Street's current expectations.
Traders said that there were also rumors that Micron was going to host a conference call with analysts and investors earlier on Tuesday, but it was cancelled.
Shares of Micron closed down 5-3/8 to 18-5/8 in heavy trading and other PC stocks fell in sympathy.
Micron investor relations officials also did not return calls seeking comment.
One trader said that one rumor was that Micron is not able to ship a certain PC because it is not getting enough of a high-end processor from Intel Corp.
